title: People who remember every second of their life  | 60 Minutes Australia
summary: A 60 Minutes Australia segment on people with highly superior autobiographical memory, who can recall the details of any day of their lives. It presents the rare phenomenon through interviews with people who have it.
why: HN links it as an example of extraordinary episodic memory in threads on memory and knowledge.

quote.text: Some quite clearly have incredible abilities in this regard
